protocol.scope: Retrospective Final Test comparison; no tuning. Ungated native peaks, same stored detector centers as V11, no detector replay or V11 inference rerun. Not full firmware quality gate.
protocol.matching: greedy one-to-one nearest within38 samples; BEATS=NLRBAaJSVrFejnE/fQ?
protocol.accounting: all missed V=FN; missing N abstention not TN; matched OTHER excluded N/V; unmatched PVC alarms=FP; unmatched does not mean noise
protocol.preprocessing: exact final V11 test signal/ADC reconstruction, center-128:center+128, float32 window z-score
protocol.RR: V11 cached output uses current/prior detector peaks, locked Fit scaling; no annotation RR
protocol.restriction: No subsequent model/detector/threshold optimization from these Test results
